backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments with blob storage, study planner tasks with date/time/priority, and conversation history with access control and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five requirements for improving bullet point formatting in notesCleanerFormat.ts: removing old logic, preserving scientific compound terms, implementing smart splitting without conjunctions, preserving complete sentences, and validating against single-word/conjunction-led bullets.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages (HomePage, AssignmentFormatPage, StudyPlannerPage, NotesCleanerPage, etc.), components (Layout, StudentSathiAssistant), hooks (useQueries), and configuration files with detailed feature descriptions.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Contains the current production version number (73) used by CI/CD to promote draft versions to the Live/Production channel.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documentation for production version management explaining that production-version.txt contains a single numeric draft version to promote to Live/Production channel via metadata-only CI/CD operations.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes with student-friendly soft purple/blue primary colors and proper contrast.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, page title 'StudentSathi Student Helper Website', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages (home, assignment-format, study-planner, notes-cleaner, leave-application, resume-builder, request-feature), ThemeProvider for light/dark mode, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Multi-language chatbot component with voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, message history, download options (PDF/Word/Text), and language-specific UI translations for assignment assistance.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with sticky header, responsive navigation (desktop and mobile sheet menu), and footer. Includes links to all major app sections and branding.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable button component with multiple variants (default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link) and sizes (sm, default, lg, icon). Supports asChild prop for composition.
Card component primitives including Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter with consistent styling and spacing.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Sheet (side drawer) component with context-based state management, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, backdrop overlay, and close functionality.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder Toaster component that returns null; intended for future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: AI chat assistant component with voice input, image OCR (Tesseract.js), text-to-speech, and assignment generation features. Manages conversation state, confirmation flows, and integrates with backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Documentation file indicating that DailyProgressChart.tsx should remain unchanged during weekly chart fixes.
Daily progress visualization with donut chart showing completed vs pending tasks, total time, and color-coded stats grid. Calculates percentages and formats durations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Container component that conditionally renders either DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on viewType prop.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Small badge component displaying subject name with color-coded styling based on subject type or custom color.
A searchable dropdown component for filtering study tasks by subject, displaying subject names with task counts and highlighting the selected subject.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: Displays a donut chart and statistics grid showing weekly study progress including total tasks, completed/pending counts, and total study time for completed tasks only.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with AuthClient, managing identity state and login status throughout the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for feature requests, assignment generation (frontend-only), conversation saving, and study planner task management (add/update/delete/toggle) with backend actor integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: Custom hook that persists and manages the study planner sort mode preference ('default' or 'dateTime') in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: Custom hook that independently persists subject filter state for daily and weekly study planner views in localStorage, returning the appropriate filter based on active view.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: Custom hook that persists and manages the study planner view preference ('daily' or 'weekly') in localStorage, defaulting to 'weekly'.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for UI components (primary, secondary, accent, destructive, sidebar, charts) and a utility override for line-through.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
Multi-language assignment and project formatting tool with title page editor, format settings (font, spacing, page numbering), content editor with word count, AI improvement features, and export options (PDF, Word, Text) with subject-specific headings and reference helpers.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero section and grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request Feature) with navigation to respective pages.
Leave application generator that takes student name, date, and reason as inputs and produces a formatted leave letter with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Notes cleaning tool that converts rough notes into formatted text with options for bullet points, paragraph-to-points conversion, definition style, auto-heading detection, and download as text file.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Feature request form allowing users to submit suggestions for new tools with optional email contact, using a mutation hook to persist requests to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: React component for a resume builder form that collects personal info, education, skills, and projects, then generates a formatted text resume that can be copied to clipboard.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: Main Study Planner page component managing task creation, display, filtering, sorting, and export with support for both authenticated (backend) and guest (localStorage) modes, including daily/weekly views and progress charts.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Defines bullet style configuration for Notes Cleaner, currently locked to dash style with infrastructure for future expansion to dot, number, and arrow styles.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Core formatting engine for Notes Cleaner that auto-detects headings and implements smart semantic splitting to preserve scientific terms, complete sentences, and compound phrases while converting text to bullet points.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Handles TXT file download for cleaned notes with auto-generated filenames based on first word and date, or custom user-provided names.
Utility functions to parse duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours', '30 minutes') into minutes and format minutes back into human-readable duration strings.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: LocalStorage-based persistence layer for Study Planner guest mode, managing CRUD operations for tasks with automatic legacy data migration to remove deprecated colorOverride fields.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Generates a printable HTML document from study tasks that opens in a new window for PDF printing via browser's print dialog. Includes task details, completion status, and summary statistics formatted for clean printing.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting utilities for study tasks with two modes: default (by task ID/creation order) and dateTime (chronological with tasks lacking dates sorted last). Uses task IDs to break ties for stable sorting.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Handles conversion between HTML date/time inputs and backend timestamp formats (bigint nanoseconds for backend, number milliseconds for guest). Provides formatting functions for displaying date and time in human-readable format.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports study tasks to a plain text file with Notepad-friendly formatting including headers, task details, completion status, and summary counts. Creates a downloadable .txt file via blob URL.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides weekly date calculation utilities for study planner, handling both backend bigint nanoseconds and guest number milliseconds. Includes functions for getting current week boundaries (Monday-Sunday), checking if dates fall within the current week, and normalizing date formats.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Centralized color mapping system for academic subjects with predefined color assignments (e.g., Mathematics=blue, Science=green). Provides functions to get badge and indicator bar color classes with dark mode support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing. Includes sessionStorage persistence for parameters and functions to clear sensitive data from URLs without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, sidebar colors, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a note formatting tool with smart semantic bullet splitting engine that preserves scientific compound terms and prevents over-splitting by applying semantic grouping before bullet conversion.
unknown.txt: Requirements document describing an assignment formatting tool with features including editable fields, word counter, PDF/Word/text download, subject heading panel, citation helper, teacher checklist, and an embedded "Student Sathi Assistant" chatbot with context-aware help in Urdu positioned at bottom-right.
